subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “A tall student noticed that younger students were getting wet at the edge.”?
options: Then she gave students permission to add important dates.
It simply gave others a way to notice them.
He stepped into the rain and gave them space.
Others gave very short answers, like "food" or "sleep."
